21{
22    //Process a play result submitted via AJAX. Takes explicit values, no cookies.
23    //$seconds: Time spent on the problem, in seconds.
24    //$setConnectionID: Part of the set the problem is played from; null means
25    //the display set connection is deduced instead.
26    //$pageMode: Mode of the page the problem was played on, see playMode(); null means the stored mode.
27    //Returns result with xp_gained, new_rating, new_xp, new_level, new_damage, status,
28    //potion_triggered and achievement_updates, and in the mistake training
29    //mistake_training_button.
30    public function processResult(int $tsumegoID, PlayOutcome $outcome, float $seconds, ?int $setConnectionID = null, ?int $pageMode = null): array
31    {
32        Auth::overrideMode($this->playMode($tsumegoID, $pageMode));
33        try
34        {
35            return $this->processResultInPlayMode($tsumegoID, $outcome, $seconds, $setConnectionID);
36        }
37        finally
38        {
39            Auth::overrideMode(null);
40        }
41    }
42
43    //The mode a result counts in, when it is not the stored one. The mode is stored on
44    //the player, and opening another mode in another tab, or going back to a page in
45    //the browser history, switches it under a page that is still open, so the page says
46    //which mode it was played in. A page of the training counts as training only while
47    //the problem is in today's training, so claiming it spares no hearts on any other
48    //problem. A page of a normal mode counts in its own mode when the stored one is the
49    //training, which is what the other tab switched to. Any other disagreement keeps
50    //the stored mode.
51    private function playMode(int $tsumegoID, ?int $pageMode): ?int
52    {
53        $storedMode = Auth::getMode();
54        if ($pageMode === null || $pageMode === $storedMode)
55            return null;
56
57        if ($pageMode === Constants::$MISTAKE_TRAINING_MODE)
58        {
59            $row = MistakeTraining::getPoolRow((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
60            return $row !== null && MistakeTraining::isInTodaysTraining($row) ? $pageMode : null;
61        }
62
63        $normalModes = [Constants::$LEVEL_MODE, Constants::$RATING_MODE, Constants::$TIME_MODE];
64        if ($storedMode === Constants::$MISTAKE_TRAINING_MODE && in_array($pageMode, $normalModes, true))
65            return $pageMode;
66        return null;
67    }

69    private function processResultInPlayMode(int $tsumegoID, PlayOutcome $outcome, float $seconds, ?int $setConnectionID): array
70    {
71        $seconds = max(0.01, $seconds);
72        $solved = $outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedClean || $outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedAfterMistake;
73
74        $tsumego = ClassRegistry::init('Tsumego')->findById($tsumegoID);
75        if (!$tsumego)
76            return ['error' => 'Tsumego not found'];
77
78        if (Auth::isInTimeMode())
79        {
80            $timeMode = new TimeMode();
81            $playResult = ['solved' => $solved];
82            $timeMode->processPlayResult($tsumego, $playResult, $seconds, $outcome === PlayOutcome::TimedOut);
83        }
84
85        $result = [];
86        $result['solved'] = $solved;
87
88        $tsumegoStatus = ClassRegistry::init('TsumegoStatus')->find('first', [
89            'conditions' => [
90                'tsumego_id' => $tsumegoID,
91                'user_id' => (int) Auth::getUserID(),
92            ],
93        ]);
94
95        $previousStatusValue = $tsumegoStatus ? $tsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status'] : TsumegoStatus::$NOT_VISITED;
96        $this->processDamage($result, $previousStatusValue);
97        $newStatus = $this->updateTsumegoStatus($tsumego, $result, $tsumegoStatus);
98        if (TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($newStatus) && !TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($previousStatusValue))
99            SetCompletionCounter::updateAfterSolve((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
100
101        if (HeroPowers::getSprintRemainingSeconds() > 0)
102            $result['xp-modifier'] = ($result['xp-modifier'] ?: 1) * Constants::$SPRINT_MULTIPLIER;
103
104        $originalTsumegoRating = $tsumego['Tsumego']['rating'];
105
106        // the resets of the part of the set the problem is played from, in the last month
107        $progressDeletionCount = ProgressDeletionTable::countRecentForProblem(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $setConnectionID);
108
109        $lastTsumegoAttempt = TsumegoAttempt::findLast((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
110
111        $this->processRatingChange($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $progressDeletionCount, TsumegoAttempt::failsInARow($lastTsumegoAttempt));
112        if (!$result['solved'])
113            $result['potion_triggered'] = $this->processPotion();
114        $this->processXpChange($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $originalTsumegoRating, $progressDeletionCount);
115        $this->updateTsumegoAttempt($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $seconds, $lastTsumegoAttempt);
116        ClassroomAssignmentTable::recordResult((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $outcome);
117        // The pool is fed from every mode: a solved problem that goes wrong enters the
118        // review ladder, a clean solve climbs it. The training says it is the one playing, since a replay there counts for nothing,
119        // and so does the time mode, the one mode where a solved problem is not free play.
120        $trainingXp = null;
121        $review = MistakeTraining::recordResult(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $outcome, $previousStatusValue, Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode(), Auth::isInTimeMode());
122        if ($review !== null && Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
123            $trainingXp = $this->processTrainingXp($review, (float) $originalTsumegoRating);
124        $this->processErrorAchievement($result, $previousStatusValue, $outcome);
125        $this->processUnsortedStuff($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue);
126        $this->processGoldenRun($result, $previousStatusValue);
127
128        // Check solve-dependent achievements right away (not only on the next page
129        // load) so the user sees the popup immediately after solving.
130        $achievementChecker = new AchievementChecker();
131        $achievementChecker->checkStandardAchievements()->finalize();
132
133        $response = [
134            'xp_gained' => $trainingXp !== null ? array_sum($trainingXp) : ($result['xp-gained'] ?? 0),
135            'new_rating' => Auth::getUser()['rating'],
136            'new_xp' => Auth::getUser()['xp'],
137            'new_level' => Auth::getUser()['level'],
138            'new_damage' => Auth::getUser()['damage'],
139            'status' => $newStatus,
140            'potion_triggered' => $result['potion_triggered'] ?? false,
141        ];
142        if (!empty($achievementChecker->updated))
143            $response['achievement_updates'] = $achievementChecker->updated;
144        // The training row shows what today did with the problem, and this result just
145        // changed it, so the page redraws the button from the review as it was stored.
146        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
147        {
148            $response['mistake_training_button'] = MistakeTraining::describeTodaysReview(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
149            $response['mistake_training_xp'] = $trainingXp ?? ['review' => 0, 'graduation' => 0, 'clear' => 0];
150        }
151
152        return $response;
153    }

155    //The XP of a review in the training (see MistakeTraining::REVIEW_XP_SHARE). It
156    //counts like the XP of a solve, for the level and the day's XP; the bonus for
157    //clearing the day is not a solve, so it leaves the day's solved count alone.
158    /**
159     * @param array{id: int, result: int, climbed: bool, clear_bonus: bool} $review
160     * @return array{review: int, graduation: int, clear: int}
161     */
162    private function processTrainingXp(array $review, float $problemRating): array
163    {
164        $xp = MistakeTraining::awardXp((int) Auth::getUserID(), $review, $problemRating);
165        if (array_sum($xp) == 0)
166            return $xp;
167
168        $user = & Auth::getUser();
169        if ($xp['review'] + $xp['graduation'] > 0)
170            Level::addXPAsResultOfTsumegoSolving($user, $xp['review'] + $xp['graduation']);
171        if ($xp['clear'] > 0)
172        {
173            Level::addXP($user, $xp['clear']);
174            $user['daily_xp'] += $xp['clear'];
175        }
176        Auth::saveUserFields([
177            'xp' => $user['xp'],
178            'level' => $user['level'],
179            'daily_xp' => $user['daily_xp'],
180            'daily_solved' => $user['daily_solved'],
181        ]);
182        return $xp;
183    }

194    //Potion: triggers after a fail when damage meets or exceeds max health.
195    public function processPotion(): bool
196    {
197        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
198            return false;
199        if (!HeroPowers::canPotionTrigger())
200            return false;
201
202        $excessDeaths = Auth::getUser()['damage'] - Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']);
203        $chance = min($excessDeaths * HeroPowers::$POTION_CHANCE_PER_DEATH, 100);
204
205        if (rand(1, 100) <= $chance)
206        {
207            Auth::saveUserFields([
208                'damage' => 0,
209                'used_potion' => 1,
210            ]);
211            return true;
212        }
213
214        AchievementCondition::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_POTION);
215        return false;
216    }

218    private function getNewStatus(bool $solved, string $currentStatus, array &$result): string
219    {
220        if ($solved)
221        {
222            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$REVIEW) // half xp state
223            {$result['xp-modifier'] = ($result['xp-modifier'] ?: 1) * Constants::$SECOND_SOLVE_XP_MULTIPLIER;
224                return TsumegoStatus::$MASTERED; // double solved
225            }
226            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$GOLDEN)
227            {
228                $result['xp-modifier'] = ($result['xp-modifier'] ?: 1) * Constants::$GOLDEN_TSUMEGO_XP_MULTIPLIER;
229                return TsumegoStatus::$SOLVED;
230            }
231            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$VISITED || $currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$NOT_VISITED)
232                return TsumegoStatus::$SOLVED;
233            return $currentStatus; // failed can't be unfailed by solving, user has to wait until next day or rejuvenation
234        }
235
236        // not solved from now
237        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$VISITED) // if it was just visited so far (so we don't overwrite solved)
238        {if (Auth::getUser()['damage'] > Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']))
239            return TsumegoStatus::$LOCKED;  // only mark as failed when the user has no hearts left
240            return $currentStatus;
241        }
242        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$REVIEW)
243        {
244            if (Auth::getUser()['damage'] > Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']))
245                return TsumegoStatus::$FORGOTTEN; // only mark as 'stale failed' when the user has no hearts left
246            return $currentStatus;
247        }
248        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatus::$GOLDEN)
249            return TsumegoStatus::$VISITED; // failed golden tsumego
250        return $currentStatus;
251    }

253    private function updateTsumegoStatus(array $previousTsumego, array &$result, ?array $previousTsumegoStatus): string
254    {
255        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
256            return $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status'] ?? TsumegoStatus::$NOT_VISITED;
257
258        if ($previousTsumegoStatus == null)
259        {
260            $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus'] = [];
261            $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['user_id'] = Auth::getUserID();
262            $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['tsumego_id'] = $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['id'];
263            $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status'] = TsumegoStatus::$VISITED;
264        }
265
266        $newStatus = $this->getNewStatus($result['solved'], $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status'], $result);
267
268        if (TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($newStatus) && !TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status']))
269            Auth::incrementUserField('solved', 1);
270        $previousTsumegoStatus['TsumegoStatus']['status'] = $newStatus;
271        ClassRegistry::init('TsumegoStatus')->save($previousTsumegoStatus);
272        return $newStatus;
273    }

275    private function updateTsumegoAttempt(array $previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, float $seconds, ?array $lastTsumegoAttempt): void
276    {
277        if (Auth::isInTimeMode() || Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
278            return;
279        if (TsumegoUtil::isRecentlySolved($previousTsumegoStatus))
280            return;
281
282        // only not solved ones are updated (misplays get accumulated)
283        if (!$lastTsumegoAttempt || $lastTsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['solved'])
284        {
285            $tsumegoAttempt = [];
286            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['user_id'] = Auth::getUserID();
287            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['tsumego_id'] = $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['id'];
288            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['seconds'] = 0;
289            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['solved'] = $result['solved'];
290            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['tsumego_rating'] = $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['rating'];
291            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['misplays'] = 0;
292        }
293        else
294            $tsumegoAttempt = $lastTsumegoAttempt;
295
296        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['user_rating'] = Auth::getUser()['rating'];
297        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['gain'] = $result['xp-gained'] ?: 0;
298        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['seconds'] += $seconds;
299        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['solved'] = $result['solved'];
300        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['tsumego_rating'] = $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['rating'];
301        if ($result['solved'])
302            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['misplays'] = (int) $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['misplays'];
303        else
304            $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['misplays'] = (int) $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['misplays'] + 1;
305        $tsumegoAttempt['TsumegoAttempt']['created'] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
306        ClassRegistry::init('TsumegoAttempt')->save($tsumegoAttempt);
307    }

309    private static function processRatingChangeStep(float &$userRating, float &$tsumegoRating, bool $isWin): void
310    {
311        $userRatingDelta = Rating::calculateRatingChange($userRating, $tsumegoRating, $isWin ? 1 : 0, Constants::$PLAYER_RATING_CALCULATION_MODIFIER);
312        $tsumegoRatingDelta = Rating::calculateRatingChange($tsumegoRating, $userRating, $isWin ? 0 : 1, Constants::$TSUMEGO_RATING_CALCULATION_MODIFIER);
313        $userRating += $userRatingDelta;
314        $tsumegoRating += $tsumegoRatingDelta;
315    }

317    private function processRatingChange(array &$previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, int $progressDeletionCount, int $failsInARow): void
318    {
319        if (!Auth::ratingisGainedInCurrentMode())
320            return;
321        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
322            return;
323
324        // After a reset of its part in the last month the problem is known, solving it again says little
325        // about the player or the problem, so neither rating changes.
326        if ($progressDeletionCount != 0)
327            return;
328
329        // Failing the same problem again and again tells nothing new about the player or the problem,
330        // so only the first fails in a row change the ratings, until the problem is solved.
331        if (!$result['solved'] && $failsInARow >= Constants::$MAXIMUM_RATED_FAILS_IN_A_ROW)
332            return;
333
334        $userRating = (float) Auth::getUser()['rating'];
335        $originalTsumegoRating = (float) $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['rating'];
336        $tsumegoRating = $originalTsumegoRating;
337
338        // Each AJAX call is a single atomic event: fail or solve, never both.
339        // Prior misplays were already processed by their own AJAX calls.
340        self::processRatingChangeStep($userRating, $tsumegoRating, $result['solved']);
341
342        Auth::saveUserFields([
343            'rating' => $userRating,
344            'highest_rating' => max((float) Auth::getUser()['highest_rating'], $userRating)]);
345
346        $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['rating'] = Util::clampOptional(
347            $tsumegoRating,
348            $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['minimum_rating'],
349            $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['maximum_rating']);
350        Tsumego::addToRating((int) $previousTsumego['Tsumego']['id'], $tsumegoRating - $originalTsumegoRating);
351    }

364    private function processXpChange(array $previousTsumego, array &$result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, int|float|string $originalTsumegoRating, int $progressDeletionCount): void
365    {
366        if (!Auth::XPisGainedInCurrentMode())
367            return;
368        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
369            return;
370        if (!$result['solved'])
371            return;
372
373        $multiplier = ($result['xp-modifier'] ?: 1);
374        if ($previousTsumegoStatus != TsumegoStatus::$GOLDEN)
375            $multiplier *= TsumegoXPAndRating::getProgressDeletionMultiplier($progressDeletionCount);
376
377        $user = & Auth::getUser();
378        $result['xp-gained'] = Rating::ratingToXP($originalTsumegoRating, $multiplier);
379        Level::addXPAsResultOfTsumegoSolving($user, $result['xp-gained']);
380        Auth::saveUserFields([
381            'xp' => $user['xp'],
382            'level' => $user['level'],
383            'daily_xp' => $user['daily_xp'],
384            'daily_solved' => $user['daily_solved'],
385        ]);
386    }

388    private function processErrorAchievement(array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, PlayOutcome $outcome): void
389    {
390        if (!Auth::XPisGainedInCurrentMode())
391            return;
392        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
393            return;
394
395        // The streak counts the problems solved since the last error: only a clean solve
396        // extends it, anything else resets it.
397        if ($outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedClean)
398            AchievementCondition::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_NO_ERROR_STREAK);
399        else
400            AchievementCondition::put(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_NO_ERROR_STREAK, 0);
401    }

403    private function processUnsortedStuff(array $previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus): void
404    {
405        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
406            return;
407        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
408            return;
409        if (!$result['solved'])
410            return;
411
412        $solvedTsumegoRank = Rating::getReadableRankFromRating($previousTsumego['Tsumego']['rating']);
413        if (isset(AchievementCondition::DAN_SOLVE_CATEGORIES[$solvedTsumegoRank]))
414            AchievementCondition::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::DAN_SOLVE_CATEGORIES[$solvedTsumegoRank]);
415        DayRecordTable::countGemSolve($solvedTsumegoRank);
416        //The sprint run counts the problems solved in a row while a sprint is active (user.sprint_start)
417        if (HeroPowers::getSprintRemainingSeconds() > 0)
418            AchievementCondition::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_SPRINT);
419        else
420            AchievementCondition::put(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_SPRINT, 0);
421    }
422
423    //The Gold Digger run counts the golden tsumego solved in a row. A golden tsumego is a
424    //single attempt, so a solve moves the run one further and a fail starts it over.
425    private function processGoldenRun(array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus): void
426    {
427        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
428            return;
429        if ($previousTsumegoStatus != TsumegoStatus::$GOLDEN)
430            return;
431        if ($result['solved'])
432            AchievementCondition::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementCondition::CATEGORY_GOLDEN);
433        else

435    }
